messages.text: Inventory check: Atlas Robotics order 1042 is exposed if Zeta Components misses the bearing shipment again.
Supplier Zeta moved expected ship date from June 3 to June 6.
Decision: keep Atlas on watchlist and update customer only if delay extends past June 5.
Follow-up owner is Nina from supply chain.
I own the supplier follow-up and will confirm by end of day.
Order 1042 looked back on track after warehouse freed 20 units from reserve.
That only helps partially. We still need 40 bearings from Zeta.
Noted. Leaving status as tentative, not confirmed.
Supplier email still says June 6 ETA, so risk remains.
North warehouse cycle count found Sigma valve stock lower than system count by 18 units.
Potential discrepancy affects orders 1051 and 1055.
Please validate before we escalate.
I will recount tonight.
We should not promise Atlas Robotics a date change until ops confirms supply.
Approved. Keep communication factual and avoid offering discount yet.
Sales will hold outbound update until Nina confirms.
Decision: prioritize Helios Health order 1048 over lower-margin regional orders if inventory tightens.
Logged. Ops will reserve available Sigma valves for 1048 first.
Customer is strategic tier A, so that aligns.
Atlas Robotics asked whether shipment will leave this week.
I told them we are checking with ops and would respond tomorrow.
Do not confirm until supplier risk is cleared.
Atlas account sounds nervous and mentioned possible penalty if we slip past June 7.
Customer context: they care more about certainty than speed right now.
Understood. I'll avoid reassuring language until ops is firm.
Helios Health requested split shipment if Sigma valves arrive short.
No decision yet. Need ops feasibility view by tomorrow noon.
I'll hold customer response.
Supplier Zeta admitted partial production stoppage on bearing line.
Risk level is medium-high through June 6.
They offered expedited freight if line restarts tomorrow.
Supplier Orion confirmed Sigma valves ship June 4 as planned.
Delay risk low.
This supports Helios order 1048 unless cycle count issue is real.
Atlas follow-up: Zeta has not yet sent ASN. Still expecting June 6.
So no proof the shipment has moved.
Correct, only verbal assurance.
Deadline update: recount on Sigma valves finishes by 20:00 today.
If shortage confirmed, we may need discrepancy alert.
No action until recount evidence is in.
Ownership change: Carlos will manage Order 1055 handoff instead of Priya.
Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with warehouse west.
We still have conflicting signals on Atlas. No executive escalation unless structured data shows material slip.
Agreed. Need evidence, not thread noise.
Random note: who keeps stealing the cold brew from the fridge?
Not me.
Please open a separate channel for beverage crime.
